items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: Because of Sun White is responsible for my son. Huh? For my son getting his practical training.

ctx.x: Mmhmm. Well that's so hard for me to remember all the young people.

But my big son he'll alternate. He'll he'll he'll play the bass drum or the snare drum. He sound good. He actually got a better Dixieland beat than a rock and roll. Because of Sun White is responsible for my son. Huh? For my son getting his practical training.
Did they work together or did you work together?
